title: 2026 Alberta Referendum: All 10 Questions & Demographic Vote Anatomy

questions.shortTitle: Provincial control of immigration & job priority
questions.prompt: Support Alberta taking increased control over immigration to decrease levels, prioritize economic migration, and give Albertans first priority on new jobs?

questions.shortTitle: Restrict provincial programs to citizens/PR/approved status
questions.prompt: Mandate that only Canadian citizens, permanent residents, and individuals with Alberta-approved status qualify for provincially funded health, education, and social services?
Require individuals with non-permanent legal immigration status to reside in Alberta at least 12 months before qualifying for provincially funded social support?

questions.shortTitle: Healthcare & education fee/premium for non-permanent status
questions.prompt: Charge a reasonable fee or premium to individuals with non-permanent immigration status for their and their family's use of healthcare and education?

questions.shortTitle: Proof of citizenship required to vote
questions.prompt: Require individuals to provide proof of citizenship (passport, birth certificate, or citizenship card) to vote in an Alberta provincial election?

questions.shortTitle: Provincial selection of King's Bench & Appeal judges
questions.prompt: Work with willing provinces to amend the Constitution so provincial governments, not Ottawa, select King's Bench and Appeal court justices?
Work with willing provinces to amend the Canadian Constitution to abolish the unelected federal Senate?

questions.shortTitle: Opt out of federal social programs with full funding
questions.prompt: Amend the Constitution to allow provinces to opt out of federal programs in health, education, and social services without losing associated federal funding?

questions.shortTitle: Provincial law priority over conflicting federal law
questions.prompt: Amend the Constitution to give provincial laws in provincial or shared jurisdiction priority over conflicting federal laws?

questions.shortTitle: Remain in Canada vs. commence binding separation referendum
questions.prompt: Should Alberta remain a province of Canada (Option 1), or should the Government of Alberta commence the legal process to hold a binding referendum on separating from Canada (Option 2)?
